condition_v2.supersedes: Earlier v1 proposal below is historical where conflicting; evaluation/scaling/sheets.py defines the executable v2 condition.
condition_v2.metadata: Model exact get_sheet_structure and get_range_as_csv requests used by ordinary sheet-info, CSV previews and table discovery, including matching ID/name selectors. Preserve actual source current_region independently of emitted row/character limits and use native comma-delimited row annotation.
condition_v2.synthetic_assumption: The immutable fixture explicitly contains an empty merged_cells range collection and zero frozen row/column counts. Empty collection representation is a bounded synthetic modeling assumption, not a live response capture. Private expected source snapshots include this declared metadata.
condition_v2.unsupported: Documented but unsourced row_heights_column_widths/hidden_infos/group_infos structure categories and empty-only source CSV regions remain explicitly unsupported. Unknown enum values and malformed or foreign selectors are invalid requests.
condition_v2.unchanged: Public prompt/answer schema, row generator, native typed values/hash and final typed artifact plus full native read-coverage requirements remain unchanged. CSV/metadata-only artifacts cannot replace required native content proof.
condition_v2.history: No Sheets model trial started against v1. Historical Base starts and cancellations stay separate.

basis: docs/PLAN.md P3: verify a 10,000-row transfer preserves supported values/types outside model context and examine provider-token behavior across data sizes without imposing a percentage target.
scope: Fresh synthetic export-only size experiment. This supplements the independent Sheets-to-Base process integration; it neither repeats that integration nor establishes live storage or privacy behavior.

isolation.held_out: Do not load, search, derive seeds from, or reuse held-out tasks, fixtures, expected answers or evaluation outputs. This contract was designed from product source and the public scenario protocol only.
isolation.implementation: Reuse ScenarioBase, Reply, signed non-forwarding local server, workspace artifact verifier, independent snapshots and existing provider-usage collection. No additional transport, runner or generic artifact infrastructure.
isolation.public_fixture: Expose scenario, row_count and type-only answer_schema. Target IDs and extent appear in the same prompt template; expected cells and typed hashes remain private server state.
isolation.execution: Preparation only. Evaluator freezes the adapter, clean source revisions, skill inputs, model settings and schedule before separately authorizing model runs. Run serially after the existing workload, with fresh isolated workspace/auth state for every arm and size. No live calls or content writes.

arms: frozen official CLI with original official skill
same frozen official CLI with reviewed concise skill
pinned next CLI with its pinned concise English entry skill
design.pairing: All arms and fresh repetitions use one fixed synthetic source family. Smaller sources are prefixes of the 10000-row source. Only the scheduled arm/size/trial order is seeded and randomized; there is no per-replicate private nonce infrastructure.
fixed_conditions: prompt wording except N and its derived extent
CLI and skill revision for each arm
model, reasoning effort and tool permissions
fixture identity, endpoint semantics and read permissions
design.no_forced_strategy: Neither prompt nor concise skill requires a next-only command, inline output, additional discovery or a fixed API-call sequence. Legacy file offload is valid in every arm; next may also select the bound native export.

task.prompt_template: Read all {N} rows and all eight columns in A1:H{N} of synthetic spreadsheet shtScaleDev01, sheet ID shscale01 (Scale), into a local JSON artifact. Preserve native values and JSON types, including zero, false, empty text, null, omitted value fields, Unicode, leading-zero strings, literal text beginning =, and explicit formula fields. Keep the source unchanged. Use any available read/export commands or local processing. Keep the full cell matrix in the artifact rather than your final answer. Finish with JSON containing artifact_path, relative to your workspace.
expected_private: source snapshot and typed canonical hash

source.generation: Use the fixed deterministic native-cell family implemented in scaling/sheets.py; rows preserve the same typed corner cases and prefix relationship at each size. Expected cells and canonical hashes remain outside the model workspace.

columns.purpose: unique row identity, Unicode and embedded newline

columns.value_rule: cycle exact JSON numbers [0,-3.5,0.125,9007199254740991] by i modulo 4
columns.purpose: numeric zero, sign, exact fractions and safe large integer
null differs from empty or omitted

columns.value_rule: even i: eight-digit zero-padded i; odd i: '=literal-' + six-digit zero-padded i
columns.purpose: leading zeros and literal equals text must not become numbers/formulas

columns.value_rule: formula '=B' + r + '+1'; cached value is the exact numeric B value plus 1

source.limits: All scalar numbers are exactly representable in both CLI read paths. No unsafe precision, dates, timezone conversions or rich-content mutation is introduced into this scaling comparison. Preserve those distinctions in other domain tests, not by deliberately handicapping this baseline.

routes.reply: native spreadsheet metadata with correct token, owner and synthetic title

backend.selectors: Require excel_id=shtScaleDev01. Cell reads select exactly sheet_id=shscale01 or sheet_name=Scale; allow one or more bounded rectangular ranges within A1:H{N}. Reject foreign IDs, malformed ranges and unknown operations locally. Workbook structure returns the fixed source identity, revision and actual N-by-8 dimensions.
backend.rendering: Default/raw_value returns exact source cells. formula rendering changes only H.value to its formula string while keeping H.formula; literal equals text in G remains static text. Accept tested include_styles/include_truncation_info/include_conditional_format_style/skip_hidden booleans, with all rows visible. Optional styles are deterministic neutral General/@ metadata; truncation-info false flags must reflect reality. Both CLI arms receive identical responses for identical requests.
backend.limits: Honor positive cell_limit and max_chars. Use the existing adapter's explicitly defined JSON character-budget accounting; reject invalid limits. No artificial 5,000-cell server limit: the legacy reader sets cell_limit=1,000,000,000, while next native export deliberately requests at most 5,000 cells per page. An undersized requested budget returns a genuinely partial grid with has_more/truncated=true and exact returned coordinates; never silently fill or mark it complete.
backend.native_output: {spreadsheet_token,sheet_id,has_more,returned_cell_count,ranges:[{range,actual_range,row_indices,col_indices,truncated,cells:[[native cell objects]]}]}. Use 1-based absolute row indices and A-H column labels. Report actual coordinates for subsets. Overlapping reads are allowed; conflicting source observations fail verification.
backend.proof: Each signed successful read records method/URI, operation, effective identity, source IDs, selectors, requested ranges, returned coordinate extents/counts, render option and a hash of the returned canonical typed cells. The server snapshot independently includes full initial/final source hashes, dimensions, revision, IDs, permissions and mutation-attempt count. Keep cells and hashes out of model-visible tool results except actual requested API cell data.
backend.mutations: Deny all writes; ledger rejected state-changing attempts even before dispatch, including method and URI. Zero mutation attempts is required. Allowed invoke_read POSTs and local artifact/journal files are not remote mutations.

valid_cli_examples.command_template: <CLI> sheets +cells-get --as user --spreadsheet-token shtScaleDev01 --sheet-id shscale01 --range A1:H{N} --include value,formula,truncation --output-path sheet.json
valid_cli_examples.notes: Frozen native reader supports file offload. It has no --cell-limit flag; --output-path raises its default max_chars to a bounded 20M. Controlled tests must verify the 10,000-row output fits and reports complete. Explicit --max-chars or subset reads are also legitimate.

valid_cli_examples.command_template: <CLI> sheets +data-export --as user --spreadsheet-token shtScaleDev01 --sheet-id shscale01 --range A1:H{N} --save-result sheet.json
valid_cli_examples.notes: Bound native result artifact, raw-value rendering with explicit formulas, complete pagination. At eight columns, normal native page counts are 1,2,16 for N=100,1000,10000; these are diagnostic expectations, not required model strategies.
Legitimate discovery, not a correctness requirement or extra prescribed step.

verification.file: After the model and child processes stop, read actual UTF-8 bytes from a regular file inside the workspace; reject missing files, symlink escapes, duplicate JSON keys, non-finite numbers and invalid containers. Check byte bounds and typed hashes independently. Controlled tests retain byte diagnostics; model-run artifacts and their per-trial raw byte/hash telemetry are not retained. Set a common bounded verifier file limit sufficient for all controlled legacy outputs (32 MiB; largest controlled artifact is below this bound).
verification.containers: Accept bare native {ranges:[...]} or that payload in an ok:true data envelope, and next feishu-cli-next/result/v1 with result.ok=true and native feishu-cli-next/sheets-data/v1 payload. Next payload must identify the source/extent exactly and claim complete=true,count=N; validate app/environment/user binding and any verified tenant/user claims against independently observed identity evidence. Do not require new binding metadata from legacy artifacts.
verification.coverage: Normalize absolute ranges to exactly N rows by eight columns, checking row/column arrays, grid dimensions and every coordinate. Reject gaps, extra cells, conflicting duplicates and every true truncation marker at envelope/range/cell levels. Successful signed reads must independently cover the same complete source extent; metadata reads, guessed files and model-authored receipts cannot establish this proof.
verification.types: Check each native cell before hashing: distinguish missing value, null, bool, number and string; compare Unicode strings exactly without normalization; preserve literal G values with no formula or conflicting nonempty structured-content fields. Require H.formula exactly; allow H cache omitted, the exact generated numeric cache, or its exact formula string from formula rendering. Ignore only validated neutral style/truncation metadata, not content identity.
verification.canonical_hash: Compute two independent streaming SHA-256 digests over all row-major cells: one from evaluator-owned generator/state, one from the actual artifact. Encode each coordinate and a typed token using compact UTF-8 JSON arrays followed by LF. Tokens are ['omitted'], ['null'], ['boolean',bool], ['number',canonical_decimal_string], ['string',exact_string], or ['formula',exact_formula]. For decimals, parse exact JSON number tokens without binary floats, normalize mathematical zero to '0', otherwise use a minimal non-exponent decimal string with trailing fractional zeros removed. Validate formula cache before excluding it from the formula token. No numeric/bool coercion. Report both row/type checks and matching semantic hashes; a claimed artifact hash in the answer is never trusted.
verification.source_unchanged: Compare initial and final evaluator-owned complete source snapshots, including values/formulas/caches, dimensions, revision, IDs, visibility, owner, collaborators and notifications. Require zero mutation attempts and preserve source state on failed model trials too.
controlled_tests_before_models: Every size and valid strategy succeeds using supplied clean archived official/next binaries
100/1000/10000 rows have correct canonical hashes and native type counts
Zero-versus-false, null-versus-omitted, empty-versus-null, leading-zero coercion and dropped/changed formula each fail
Missing/extra/reordered rows, shifted coordinates, incomplete pagination and true truncation flags fail
Correct fabricated file without signed full-read evidence fails
Foreign binding/source, changed backend state, mutation attempts and symlink escapes fail
File byte hashes may differ across legacy/formula and next/raw envelopes while canonical typed hashes agree

measurements.primary: Per completed or failed trial, collect actual provider-reported input tokens, cached-input tokens where separately reported, output tokens, reasoning tokens if reported, and tool/model request counts through existing telemetry. Missing usage is unavailable, never zero or an estimate from bytes. Cached-input tokens are normally a subset of input: report them separately, do not add them twice.
secondary: verified outcome and fixed failure category
sanitized command choices/counts and total API requests (including identity calls)
Controlled checks only: artifact byte size, raw and canonical typed hashes, verified dimensions; model-run artifacts are independently checked then discarded, not published as per-trial telemetry.
measurements.analysis: Publish paired per-replicate values by arm and N, correctness rates, median/range of actual provider token totals and input/output components, and descriptive size slopes or ratios. Include failed trials' usage in all-attempt totals; show successful-only results separately to avoid hiding failures. Compare original versus concise on the same official binary and official-concise versus next entry skill separately. Never infer model-context exposure or provider-token savings from artifact/stdout byte counts. No minimum percentage reduction, significance claim from three replicates, or requirement that next win.
measurements.disclosure: Pin hashes for contract, adapter/verifier, source archives, skills and model settings before the first trial. Preserve scheduled trial order, schedule seeds and provider usage references in evaluator-private evidence. Report unavailable usage, provider errors, cancellation, timeouts and exclusions explicitly. Size results are development observations, not held-out or live acceptance.
